guidance.bestFor: A narrow column of 30 version tags under a Releases heading, split by divider lines, that only scrolls up and down
agentNotes: Replace `tags` with your own list; each string is also the row `key`, so keep the values unique

guidance.bestFor: One row of 10 photo cards that pans sideways under a horizontal bar, in a box only as tall as the row
agentNotes: Each `img` loads a random picsum.photos placeholder labelled Image N; point `src` and `alt` at your own photos

whenNotToUse.when: Rows and columns of figures wider and taller than their box

guidance.bestFor: An 8 plan pricing table with a price column and 6 feature columns that pans both across and down
agentNotes: Replace `products` and `features` together; a `key` in `features` that names no product field leaves that column blank

whenNotToUse.when: One row of cards or photos that only pans sideways
Thousands of records that need sorting, paging or virtual rows

guidance.bestFor: Edges that fade only while content is hidden past them, over a photo column with a tinted round thumb
agentNotes: The masks read overflow CSS variables Base UI sets on the viewport; the radix `ScrollArea` sets none, so compute them or drop the masks there

guidance.bestFor: Full width photo cards that gain side padding once the column overflows, keeping the bar clear of the images
agentNotes: `data-has-overflow-x` and `data-has-overflow-y` come from the Base UI root only; the radix `ScrollArea` never sets them, so its gutter stays off
